explanation: The execution contains a fault in the upstream demand/provenance job. The top-level corpus supplied eight demand records, including n06-r06, and the behavioural criteria require all qualifying or fallback demand records to be selected while preserving stipulated records. Job 1 output contains only seven needs/evidence_sources and silently omits n06-r06. Job 2 preserves the exact seven-record handoff it received and ranks those records consistently, so the observed downstream omission is attributable to job_1. No function-level evidence is supplied.
cited_evidence: top_level_input.corpus includes record_id n06-r06 with need "compare selected and complete runtime evidence", demand_score 5, source_id s06, source_weight 3.
job_1 output metadata reports record_count 7 and evidence_source_count 7 despite an eight-record input corpus.
job_1 output needs and evidence_sources include n06-r01, n06-r02, n06-r03, n06-r04, n06-r05, n06-r07, and n06-r08, omitting n06-r06.
job_1 produced exact hash handoffs for needs and evidence_sources, and job_2 input contains the same seven records, indicating job_2 consumed the upstream omission rather than creating it.
